title: Exact stored input position
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $C,e,c,A,d$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. For every cursor $j$ and time $t$ at most $c\,(A(n+C(n+1)^e+1)^d+1)^2$, where $n=|x|$, the input position stored in the packed encoding of $x$ with cursor $j$ equals the input-head position of $M$ at time $t$ on an all-false input of length $n+C(n+1)^e$.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ is at most the producer horizon for $|x|$
replaced: For every source machine, parameters, instance $x$, cursor $j$, and time $t$ at most the producer horizon, the stored shifted input position equals the public oblivious input position at time $t$ over the reference length $|x| + C(|x|+1)^e$.
